title: Great pillowcase, and soft on your hair!
text: Great pillowcase, and soft on your hair!. Where has this pillowcase been all my life?! I got my hair cut, and my stylist said "Your hair is really dry and coarse in the back" I told her it always has been- just in that spot- & she told me to get a silk pillowcase- because otherwise, we rub our head all around when we sleep and it is hard on our hair & it breaks it and damages it. With silk- (and satin- but she said silk is better) your hair will slide. This damage can also happen with car headrests. The pillowcase is very soft and nice. Now I just need one for my car! Like a silk bucket seat headrest cover! (Hint hint Alaska Bear!)

product_metadata.title: ALASKA BEAR Silk Pillowcase for Hair and Skin Beauty Sleep 100 Real Mulberry Silk Anti-Aging Pillow Slip Case Cover, Queen (1pc, Black)
features: 100% Real 19 Momme Grade 6A Pure Mulberry Silk

✅【Organic Silk】We use only pure Mulberry silk, which is an organic fiber with a relatively low carbon footprint, low soil and low land impact. Mulberry leaves trees help to store carbon. Cool to the touch, sensuously smooth, hypoallergenic and breathable

✅【Natural Beauty Therapy】Dermatologists recommend natural soft silk pillows for hair and face protection, as it is less scratchy and coarse on skin than cotton or linens. Great for preventing morning bed head, dry skin and wrinkles
✅【Benefits for Skin】Prevent sleep wrinkles by providing a slippery surface to slide over instead of tugging and pulling at delicate facial skin
✅【Benefits for Hair】Protect curly hair and keep your hairdo nice while you sleep, and you don't wake up with crazy split ends or frizz by experiencing less friction
✅【Hidden Zipper】Your pillow won’t slip out the case. Beautifully finished, with interior edges stitched over
✅【Queen Size】20 x 30 inches (51 cm x 76 cm), fits most queen-sized pillows
✅【OEKO-TEX Certified】Toxic-free, made without harmful substances like formaldehyde, mercury and other heavy metals. It's completely safe and eco-friendly, skin-friendly
✅【Sleep Set】Pillow case presents with a real soft silk scrunchie; "Be like the bears in Alaska! Take care of your fur while hibernating!!"
